hero.alt: Amir Khosravi, digital developer in Wiesbaden
hero.lead: I'm Amir Khosravi, a digital developer and business administration student in Wiesbaden. I build websites, internal apps and platforms for companies — and I stay with you for four months after launch.
sv1.p: A site that loads fast, convinces on a phone and gets found on Google. With booking, gallery or shop — depending on what your customers need.
sv2.p: When spreadsheets, paper notes and chat groups are no longer enough: your own app for shifts, jobs, price checks or reports, fitted to your workflow.
sv2.c: Works on phone, tablet and PC
sv3.p: You already have a site or software, but it does not work toward your goal. I review what exists, set priorities and build the improvements.
wk.hint: Click a project to open its gallery.
pk.lead: Own products and client work — every gallery shows real screens from live operation.
pr.h2: Four months at your side after launch
pr.p: 1 month testing and 3 months free aftercare after launch, in addition to your statutory rights.
pr.t0s: Duration depends on the project, with fixed checkpoints
pr.t1s: Testing phase: you use it, I adjust
pr.t2s: Aftercare: I fix defects at no extra cost
pr.s1s: Goal, audience and scope. Free and non-binding.
pr.s2s: Scope, fixed price and schedule in writing.
pr.s3s: Regular checkpoints, your feedback goes straight in.
pr.s4s: Go-live, then the four months begin.
ab.p: I study business administration at Hochschule RheinMain and have built websites, platforms and apps for years. I understand your business model and build the technical solution myself — no hand-over loss between advice and development.
ab.f1v: Web development, product management, digital marketing
ab.f2v: Go, PostgreSQL, React, Next.js, TypeScript, self-run servers
ab.f4v: Trades, studios, shops and small teams in the Rhine-Main area
ab.f6v: Fixed price, written plan, one contact person

proj.nelurio.task: Students juggle notes, study planning and revision across several tools.
proj.nelurio.sol: Record a lecture, the AI writes the summary, schedules reviews and answers questions from your own materials.
proj.nelurio.about: Nelurio is a study platform for university students. You record a lecture, and the app turns it into a summary, plans your reviews and keeps everything for the exam in one place. I built and run it alone: backend, frontend, AI features and servers.
proj.nelurio.looks: A light, calm workspace: a clear daily plan on the dashboard, course cards in soft colours and a focus timer that grows a small forest.
proj.akstudio.task: Two websites, inquiries, projects and marketing ran in separate tools, and there was no clear view of performance.
proj.akstudio.sol: An installable owner console: inbox, deals, content, SEO, analytics, LinkedIn and push notifications in one place.
proj.akstudio.about: AK Studio is the private owner console behind my websites. I built it to bring internal work into one tool: inquiries, projects, content and marketing. It shows at a glance what works, so I can improve my digital marketing with facts.
proj.akstudio.looks: Dark, calm and clear, with gold as the only accent. A bottom bar on the phone, a slim side rail on desktop. German, English and Persian, including right-to-left.
proj.monfared.task: A heating and plumbing company in Wiesbaden ran on an older WordPress install and wanted to digitise its staff management.
proj.monfared.sol: Rebuilt as a business platform: a bilingual website with appointment requests and a staff area with roles, permissions and an audit log.
proj.monfared.about: Haustechnik Monfared is a heating, plumbing and air-conditioning company in Wiesbaden. I rebuilt its old WordPress site as a modern platform: a bilingual website where customers request appointments, and a staff area for the team.
proj.monfared.looks: The website is bright and trustworthy: a strong blue hero with a portrait of the master craftsman, key facts underneath and orange action buttons. The panel is clean and light, with a menu on the left and clear job cards.
proj.saad.task: A tattoo studio in Wiesbaden needed a site that shows its work and brings in appointment requests.
proj.saad.sol: Redesign in black and gold with a gallery, a multi-step booking flow, training pages and three languages: German, English, Persian.
proj.saad.about: SAAD Tattoo is a tattoo studio in Wiesbaden. The website shows the studio’s work, explains each tattoo category and lets visitors book step by step: category, service, date, time, confirmation. It also presents the studio’s training courses.
proj.saad.looks: Black and matte gold, huge outlined headlines and full-width photography. Calm, bold and made for people who already know what they want.
proj.washhalle.task: Services, prices and the monthly report of a car wash needed to be recorded and checked in one place.
proj.washhalle.sol: Operations app for shifts: record services, check prices automatically, flag double-checks and generate the monthly report.
proj.washhalle.about: Washhalle is an operations app for a car-wash business. The team records every service per shift, the app checks prices against the price rules and flags anything that needs a second look. The owner gets daily and monthly overviews.
proj.washhalle.looks: Fresh green on white: a dashboard with big numbers, weekly charts and clear tables, made for quick use on a phone between two cars.
proj.raha.task: An artist sells artworks to customers in Europe and Iran and needs a store she can run herself.
proj.raha.sol: A luxury storefront in Persian and English with euro prices and an admin area where the artist manages works and prices herself.
proj.raha.about: RahaVelvet is a store for an artist who sells original artworks. The design shows a calm, gallery-like site with a collection overview, detailed artwork pages and an order form. The artist will manage works, prices and availability herself in her own admin area. The project is in development.
proj.raha.looks: A warm cream background, large serif headlines and artworks presented like pieces on a gallery wall, with a deep wine red for actions.
proj.finello.task: Students in Germany need a simple overview of budget, recurring payments and spending.
proj.finello.sol: A finance app with a budget calendar, recurring payments and an expense overview.
proj.finello.about: Finello is a finance app for students in Germany. It gives one clear view of the monthly budget, recurring payments and spending, so rent, semester ticket and everyday costs are no surprise.
proj.finello.looks: A clean, light interface with a deep green summary card on top, clear numbers and a calendar that shows every payment on its day.
proj.nexdeutsch.task: Learning German needs planned repetition so vocabulary sticks.
proj.nexdeutsch.sol: A vocabulary trainer with spaced repetition, full example sentences and a Persian interface.
proj.nexdeutsch.about: NexDeutsch helps people learn German vocabulary with spaced practice. Words come back just before you would forget them, in short daily sessions organised in courses from A1.
proj.nexdeutsch.looks: A light, uncluttered interface with soft green and lilac tones. Each word sits on a large card, and a progress bar shows how far the session is.
proj.record.task: Most gym apps are overloaded or lose your history.
proj.record.sol: A mobile PWA: log sets fast, keep a record book and see next week’s target, in Persian and English, dark and light.
proj.record.about: Record Tracker is a gym app for people who want to beat their last lift. You log every set in seconds, see your best lifts in a record book and get a target for next week.
proj.record.looks: Mobile-first in dark or light, big touch targets, a green accent for the main action and numbers that stay readable between two sets.

dat.p1: The controller for data processing on this website is: __OWNER_NAME__, __OWNER_ADDRESS__, __OWNER_PLZ__ __OWNER_CITY__, email: __CONTACT_EMAIL__.
dat.p2: When you visit this website, the hoster processes technically necessary data in server log files (shortened IP address, time, requested address, browser type). The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) lit. f GDPR (secure and efficient operation). Log files are deleted after __OWNER_LOG_DAYS__ days.
dat.p3: This website uses no cookies and no third-party trackers. For anonymous, cookieless counting of clicks on contact actions, your browser sends a small event signal (event name, time, page) to /api/event on this server. No personal profiles are built and no data is shared with third parties. The signal is not sent automatically when your browser reports "Do Not Track".
dat.p4: When you use the contact form or send an email, we process the details you provide (name, email address, message, optionally company and budget) solely to handle your request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) lit. b or lit. f GDPR. The data is deleted as soon as the request is completed and no statutory retention obligations apply, at the latest after __OWNER_RETENTION_MONTHS__ months.
dat.p5: Links to services such as WhatsApp, LinkedIn and GitHub lead to external offerings. Only when you click such a link is data transmitted to the respective provider; the provider’s privacy policy applies to that processing.
dat.p6: You have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21 GDPR). You may also lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority (The Hessian Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information).
